brief:
The Palestine Red Crescent Society transferred 26 patients out of Gaza on Tuesday morning for medical treatment, with 27 companions accompanying them, according to Middle East Eye. The evacuation comes as the humanitarian situation in Gaza continues to deteriorate, with medical facilities facing severe shortages of supplies and capacity.

The patients were moved through coordination mechanisms established to allow medical evacuations from the besieged territory. No details were provided on the patients' destinations or specific medical conditions requiring treatment outside Gaza.
dek: Red Crescent evacuates 26 Palestinian patients from Gaza for treatment The Palestine Red Crescent Society transferred 26 patients out of Gaza this morning to receive medical care, with 27 companions accompanying them, Wafa reports.
title: Red Crescent evacuates 26 Palestinian patients from Gaza
